name: rlane.corpus-ingest
description: Routine-lane gate for corpus ingest routines (YouTube nightly drain, LinkedIn Studio transcript drain, Recall content fetch).

artifact.instructions: The run output names at least one concrete produced artifact a reader can check: a file path, a row count read back from a store, a URL, a decision id, or a command with its exit code.

blocked_line.instructions: The run output contains an explicit BLOCKED, FAILED, PARKED or ERROR line, or says it could not do the scheduled work. Saying there was nothing to do is NOT blocked.

counts_stated.instructions: The output states ingested or pulled count, failed or skipped count, and remaining queue count as numbers.

status_file.instructions: The output names the status or brief file written this run.

zero_progress.instructions: The run pulled or ingested zero items.

throttle_signal.instructions: The output reports a throttle, rate limit, CAPTCHA, or 429/999 response.

quality.instructions: How strong this run output is as evidence the lane's done-test was met.
criteria: Claim with no artifact or content
Names the mode or command but not the result
Artifact plus real content, no BLOCKED line
Artifact, real content, counts it can back up, and the next step or next run named

rules.reason: run reported BLOCKED/PARKED/ERROR: done-test not met
zero-progress run: check whether the lane is exhausted and should retire
output is not evidence of a met done-test

notes.done_test: Ingested, skipped, and remaining counts are stated, a status file is written, and throttle state is reported.
notes.author: routine build-out 2026-10-04 (session 2026-10-03_xdjQtAGJmfSsidtm)
notes.policy: ESCALATE-only and never_auto until calibrated with labelled runs; no BLOCK rules by design.
notes.scope: one rubric per routine lane, judges a routine RUN OUTPUT, not its definition
